topic: 在新的晚间英语班交换信息
grammarFocus: 新增：be一般疑问句、not否定、we/they与规则复数；巩固：I am/you are、姓名与班级。
title: 第2课新增 · 向新同学介绍我们与他们
instructions: 先听示范并分段跟读，再换成自己或自编的新班级信息，说6—8句短句并单独录音。至少用一次we、一次they、一个not否定句和一个be疑问句。示范朗读与自己的回答分别保存，不能只改示范中的一个姓名当作完整迁移；没有自由表达听音评阅时原音保持待评。
prompt: You meet a new classmate at an evening English class. Introduce yourself and your class in 6–8 short sentences. Use your own details or invent a small class. Say who we are and who they are. Add one negative sentence and one question with be. Use a new name, class and room. Do not copy the example.
reference: Hello, my name is Lin. I am in Class A at the evening English club. My friend Jo is in the same class. We are students in Room Six. We are not teachers at the club. Rosa and Ben are our teachers. They are friendly and ready for the class. Are you ready for the class, too?

part1: What is your name and class?
parts.part2: Introduce your class to a new student.
